trial_court: Court of the Civil Judge, Madhugiri, in R.A.No.183/78
facts_of_case: The wife Siddagangamma filed an Original Suit against her husband Basappa and another Sakamma for maintenance and a charge on properties.

legal_principles.principle: A marriage solemnized after the commencement of this Act shall be null and void if it contravenes any one of the conditions specified in Clauses (i), (iv) and (v) of Section 5.
legal_principles.held: Section 11 of the Act declares such a marriage as null and void in the following terms: Any marriage solemnized after the commencement of this Act shall be null and void and may, on a petition presented by either party thereto against the other party, be so declared by a decree of nullity if it contravenes any one of the conditions specified in Clauses (i), (iv) and (v) of Section 5.
cited_cases: YAMUNABAI ANANTRAO ADHAV v. ANANTRAO SHIVRAM ADHAV, (Year) X SCC Y

legal_principles.principle: A marriage in contravention of the condition that neither party should have a spouse living at the time of the marriage is null and void.
legal_principles.held: Clause (i) of Section 5 lays down, for a lawful marriage, the necessary condition that neither party should have a spouse living at the time of the marriage. A marriage in contravention of this condition, therefore, is null and void.
cited_cases: YAMUNABAI ANANTRAO ADHAV v. ANANTRAO SHIVRAM ADHAV, (Year) X SCC Y

outcome.final_order: The trial court's judgment and decree were confirmed, directing the husband to pay maintenance in a sum of Rs. 25/- per month and another sum of Rs. 50/- per annum towards separate residence.
